title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on today's transfer news, Toto Cup drama, EuroLeague guards and Israel's junior water polo stars.

questions.question: Slovenian striker Ester Sokler, reported to be landing in Israel for a medical and signing, is set to join which club?
questions.explanation: Sport5 reported that Sokler, who scored 11 league goals for Radnički 1923 this season, is landing in Israel ahead of signing for Maccabi Tel Aviv for around €1 million.

questions.question: In Maccabi Netanya's 3-1 Toto Cup win over Hapoel Jerusalem, 16-year-old Yarin Abuhatzira made history by becoming the youngest ever what in Toto Cup history?
questions.explanation: Sport5 reported that Abuhatzira, son of former Israel international Shimon Abuhatzira, became the youngest goalscorer in Toto Cup history.

questions.question: Fenerbahçe are reportedly closing in on guard Johnny Juzang, who spent the second half of 2025/26 at which club, averaging 14.0 points per game?
questions.explanation: Juzang signed for Zenit St. Petersburg in February 2026 and averaged 14.0 points, 2.4 rebounds and 1.9 assists over 17 games there, per ONE.

questions.question: Israel's under-16 girls water polo team opened the World Championship in Zagreb by beating South Africa by what score, after trailing 0-2 early?
questions.explanation: Israel came back from 0-2 down, led 6-4 at halftime, and closed out a 12-7 victory with three goals each from Yahali Rokach and Ori Grodman.

questions.question: Anan Khalaili, who came off the bench to set up the winning goal for Union Saint-Gilloise against Lille, joined the Belgian club in 2024 from which Israeli team?
questions.explanation: Khalaili moved to Union Saint-Gilloise from Maccabi Haifa in summer 2024 for roughly €7.5 million and has since won the Belgian league and cup double.
